purpose: Teach: 藁/便所/破片/咲かせ/襟/受かっ/刈り/恩返し

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、林間学校で藁ぶき屋根見たろ
lines.en: Riku, you saw that thatched straw roof at forest camp, right?
lines.style: Casual jab of an opener, his name tossed out fast. Wry lilt, quick pace, rising on the tag.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、新しい校舎の便所、つまりトイレを気にしてたな、桜
lines.en: And you were all worked up about the new building's benjo — the toilets, I mean — weren't you, Sakura.
lines.style: Flat deadpan mumble, correcting himself mid-line with zero energy, dry little landing on her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ガラスの破片で怪我しないように気を付けてたな
lines.en: Riku, you were being sooo careful not to cut yourself on those glass shards.
lines.style: Mock-impressed drawl, stretching the tease out, half laughing at him by the last word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、文化祭で桜を咲かせるアートしてたな、桜
lines.en: You did that art piece at the culture festival — making cherry blossoms bloom, didn't you, Sakura.
lines.style: A little more interested than he'd admit, pace picking up, small smirk surfacing on the name pun.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、シャツの襟がよれてたな
lines.en: Riku, your shirt collar was all bent out of shape, you know.
lines.style: Quick pointed jab, clipped delivery, clearly savoring the little dig at the end.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストに受かったって嬉しそうだったな、桜
lines.en: You looked pretty happy when you passed that test, Sakura.
lines.style: Softer than he means it to sound, mumbled half-praise, trailing shyly into her name.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、おじいちゃんの稲刈り、つまり稲刈りを手伝ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you helped with your grandpa's rice harvest — the actual rice cutting, I mean.
lines.style: Genuine curiosity breaking through the sarcasm, quicker pace, an unguarded warmth on the grandpa bit.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、「育ててもらった恩返しに頑張る」って言ってたな、桜
lines.en: You said you'd work hard to pay back everyone who raised you, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet and level, almost solemn for once, letting her name settle gently at the close.
